verdict.rationale: The only fee published on the service's own pages is that a certificate of good standing can be printed or validated 'at no cost'. No dollar amounts appear in the evidence for formation, annual reports, reinstatement, registered-agent changes, amendments or expedite, even though the site has pages and FAQs for those transactions. Missing for 10: published fee amounts for formation, annual report, reinstatement, amendment, registered-agent change and expedite filings, and a consolidated fee schedule.
